cues: When a liquid meets a solid, two attractions compete.
Cohesion pulls liquid molecules to each other.
Adhesion pulls them to the solid.
Water is attracted to glass more than to itself, so it climbs the wall and makes a concave meniscus.
Mercury prefers itself, so it pulls away and bulges up, convex.
